label: copy-phase re-fed w (recall position >= 3), strongest when the next output is s/y
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and 99% of activation mass sits on steps whose input is the token w being fed back (a few weak activations on s inputs). It never fires in the original or delimiter phase or on first occurrences of a token. Within w inputs it fires on only about 14%; it needs recall_idx >= 3 (mostly 3-5) and depends on which token comes next in the output: s carries the most mass, then w, y, l, d, v, a, t. The top activations are all the pattern w followed by s (often w s y) at recall position 3. Inputs other than w essentially never activate it. Gating on the output token gives F1 of about 0.58 and mass recall of about 0.87, so the dependence on the output token is graded and only partly captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: w, s, v, -, a, t; least: h, i, l, e) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: s, w, y, l; input phase: ; delimiter step: ); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=4 & t=6.
